results.id: tests/test_api_evidence.py::test_evidence_round_trip_preserves_everything

results.id: tests/test_api_evidence.py::test_evidence_rejects_bad_records

results.id: tests/test_api_evidence.py::test_gaia_query_is_explicit_and_bounded

results.id: tests/test_api_evidence.py::test_gaia_row_mapping_on_hand_constructed_rows

results.id: tests/test_api_evidence.py::test_spherex_extension_check

results.id: tests/test_api_evidence.py::test_validation_endpoint_reports_staleness_fields

results.id: tests/test_astrometry.py::test_zero_motion_limits
results.name: Zero proper motion and parallax give zero offsets in both the linear and rigorous (vector) models.

results.id: tests/test_astrometry.py::test_ra_cosine_convention_matches_astropy[60.0]
results.name: pmra = dRA/dt cos(Dec): the coordinate-RA rate is pmra/cos(Dec), as in astropy apply_space_motion.

results.id: tests/test_astrometry.py::test_ra_cosine_convention_matches_astropy[85.0]
results.name: pmra = dRA/dt cos(Dec): the coordinate-RA rate is pmra/cos(Dec), as in astropy apply_space_motion.

results.id: tests/test_astrometry.py::test_linear_model_agrees_with_rigorous_vector_geometry
results.name: Linear parallax-factor model vs independent vector propagation (6 pc, 1.28"/yr, 3 yr): agreement < 0.05 mas.

results.id: tests/test_astrometry.py::test_parallax_ellipse_geometry_with_circular_observer
results.name: Circular 1 AU observer: an ecliptic-pole source traces a circle of radius = parallax; an ecliptic-plane source a line.

results.id: tests/test_astrometry.py::test_parallax_amplitude_scales_as_inverse_distance
results.name: Doubling the distance halves the parallactic excursion (vector method, no proper motion).

results.id: tests/test_astrometry.py::test_fit_recovers_injected_motion_from_independent_model
results.name: Noisy positions from the rigorous model: fitted pm and parallax within 3 sigma; static/pm-only models rejected.

results.id: tests/test_astrometry.py::test_fit_uncertainties_are_calibrated_monte_carlo
results.name: Over 200 noise realisations the parameter pulls have std in [0.85, 1.15] and mean chi2 ~ dof.

results.id: tests/test_astrometry.py::test_identifiability_insufficient_and_underconstrained_cases
results.name: 2 epochs -> insufficient data; 3 epochs in 2 months -> parallax not constrained; 1.000-yr spacing -> degenerate.

results.id: tests/test_astrometry.py::test_distance_only_from_significant_positive_parallax
results.name: Distance is derived only for parallax/sigma >= 10; negative or weak parallax never becomes a distance.

results.id: tests/test_astrometry.py::test_exclusions_and_input_hash
results.name: Excluded measurements are not fitted but get residuals; any input change changes the hash; repeat fits are identical.

results.id: tests/test_astrometry.py::test_unusable_measurements_are_reported_not_used
results.name: Pending or position-less measurements are skipped with a warning, never silently fitted.

results.id: tests/test_astrometry.py::test_geocenter_model_is_used_by_default
results.name: The fit records the observer it used (geocentre, builtin ephemeris).

results.id: tests/test_catalog.py::test_space_motion_propagation_matches_astropy

results.id: tests/test_catalog.py::test_observer_parallax_added_separately
results.name: The observer-parallax term equals parallax x parallax factors at the observation epoch.

results.id: tests/test_catalog.py::test_covariance_propagation_matches_monte_carlo_with_correlation

results.id: tests/test_catalog.py::test_two_parameter_solution_not_propagated

results.id: tests/test_catalog.py::test_association_statuses_and_no_invented_counterpart
results.name: Unique counterpart -> matched; two within resolution -> ambiguous; none -> unmatched with a cautionary note.

results.id: tests/test_catalog.py::test_epoch_propagation_is_required_for_high_proper_motion
results.name: A 1.28"/yr source observed 10 yr after J2016.0 matches only after propagation (not with the raw catalog position).

results.id: tests/test_catalog.py::test_padded_search_radius
results.name: Search radius >= field radius + max_pm x |dt| so sources moving into the field are retrieved.

results.id: tests/test_coords.py::test_ra_wrap_edge_cases

results.id: tests/test_coords.py::test_tangent_projection_across_ra_zero

results.id: tests/test_coords.py::test_separation_across_wrap_matches_small_angle

results.id: tests/test_coords.py::test_declination_conventions

results.id: tests/test_coords.py::test_gnomonic_round_trip_and_undefined_hemisphere

results.id: tests/test_coords.py::test_pixel_origin_convention

results.id: tests/test_coords.py::test_orientation_north_up_east_left_and_rotation_sign

results.id: tests/test_coords.py::test_sip_distortion_numerical_round_trip_and_effect

results.id: tests/test_coords.py::test_wcs_description_round_trip_including_sip

results.id: tests/test_coords.py::test_local_jacobian_equals_cd_matrix

results.id: tests/test_imaging.py::test_masked_pixel_does_not_bias_fit

results.name: Barycentric observer gives no parallax; spacecraft ephemerides are refused rather than approximated silently.

results.id: tests/test_time_observer.py::test_geocenter_suitability_bound
results.name: Geocentre approximation error = parallax * r / 1 AU (165 mas, 7100 km -> < 10 microarcsec).
